---
# Copy this file to news/YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug.qmd and edit.
# The filename date is only a convention for keeping the folder tidy; the `date`
# field below is what actually orders the listing.
#
# Nothing else needs touching. The item appears automatically on the news page
# and, if it is among the six most recent, on the home page.

title: "One sentence, sentence case, no full stop"
date: 2026-01-01

# Optional. Drop the file in assets/images/news/ and point at it here. Leave the
# line out entirely if there is no image — never use a stock photo.
# image: assets/images/news/my-image.jpg

# Optional, for filtering once there are enough items to warrant it.
# categories: [paper, grant, award, thesis]
---

Write the item here. A few short paragraphs is plenty. Links work as normal:
[the paper](https://doi.org/10.1000/example).
